breakdown.description: The prompt treats the effective-length factor K as if it affected only the mode shape, even though K directly enters the Euler buckling load through the effective length K L.
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt contained a direct contradiction: it first stated to evaluate the load using the formula without the effective-length factor (π^2 E I / L^2), and then stated to compute it using the correct formula with the factor (π^2 E I / (K L)^2). The agent correctly ignored the erroneous instruction and used the standard, correct formula P_cr = π^2 E I / (K L)^2, which aligns with the ground truth.
